text:
Type: vertical cluster globe wall lamp
Use: decorative accent light on a wall; living room, hallway, bedroom, bathroom
Style: contemporary, glam, modern
Materials: white opal acrylic globes, chrome-plated metal stem and fittings
Colors: milky white, silver chrome
Shape: tall slender column of round globes in varied sizes stacked along a central stem like a string of bubbles, sculptural, narrow and light
Feel: playful, glowing, elegant, airy
Goes with: white or dark painted walls, chrome or glass accents; modern, glam or contemporary rooms

product.name: SDERSVIK
product.description: Provides an even light that is good for illuminating around a mirror and sink.
